name: Kanojo no Imouto no Azato Yuuwaku: Junai Nante Gomi desu yo Senpai
storyline:
“I’m still embarrassed just holding hands… ehehe.”

Naruse Shuya is a boy who loves pure romance because of the books he reads. He is in an innocent relationship with his classmate Hazuki Akane.
However, he gets tempted by the body of Akane’s twin sister, Hazuki Fumino, and the story begins to move.

“I have the exact same face as my big sister, but a much more erotic body than hers… You’re interested, right? ❤️ ”

It’s just the two of them in the literature club.
Even though he feels guilty toward Akane, he can’t take his eyes off Fumino’s voluptuous body.

Will he be able to resist Fumino’s temptation and stay true to his feelings for Akane…?
“Pure love is trash, senpai ❤️ ”
summary: A reverse NTR visual novel, where pure-hearted bookworm Naruse Shuya cherishes his innocent romance with his girlfriend Hazuki Akane...until her sister Fumino seduces him, escalating his desires that threaten to shatter his ideals of pure love.
